name: TOB Sunday School Profile
description: One row per Sunday School Student — the anchor point for their weekly-rewards participation (which team/group they're on). Autoname by user so truth_of_bible.sunday_school.engine can get-or-create it directly like TOB Bible Battle Rating. Created lazily the first time a student's dashboard is loaded (see api/sunday_school.py::get_dashboard), not seeded.

fields.label: Group
fields.description: Admin/teacher-assigned. Null until a teacher places this student on a team.

fields.label: Points Clock Started At
fields.description: Set the moment this student's unredeemed balance first went positive; cleared on redemption or expiry. Read-only — managed entirely by truth_of_bible.sunday_school.engine, not editable from the admin app.
